My local supermarket in Brisbane, Australia has a plaque with an Indigenous land acknowledgement on it. 

I drove past a fire station the other day which had a land acknowledgement on the side of the building. 

When you fly from Brisbane to Sydney on a domestic flight they also do a land acknowledgement over the intercom.

quoted.text: Australia’s first ever NFL game began with a land acknowledgment. This is insane. Australia also has a national sorry day where the country apologizes to the aborigines every year. If you think the US can’t get crazier, it can.  https://t.co/E5zuYY7XLR
